title: Student records administration policy is a separate public control document
summary: A distinct Student Records Administration policy exists alongside FERPA. Fragmented policy surfaces increase the risk that students only see marketing privacy language and miss records controls.
student_action: Locate both FERPA and student-records policies before signing third-party education app prompts.
school_action: Cross-link records, FERPA, and privacy notice pages from login and LMS footers.
